1.explanation:
• NumberInput/migrate-to-7.x.md: shows how the component’s props (including aria-label and invalid state) are intended to be used, and documents any accessibility notes.  
• src/components/NumberInput/NumberInput.js: the core implementation—where the input, the up/down controls, and the invalid icon are rendered and where aria attributes are set.  
• FormItem/FormItem.js & FormLabel/FormLabel.js: these define how labels and validation messages are hooked up to inputs and how accessible names should be matched; key for understanding why the aria-label and visible <label> mismatch.  
• Icon/migrate-to-7.x.md: gives background on how Carbon ships its warning icon (usually via @carbon/icons-react) and how its aria attributes are supposed to be configured.  

Together, these files let you trace how the aria-label and role attributes are applied, how labels are generated, and how the invalid icon is injected—allowing you to reproduce the missing-alt and name-mismatch violations and then adjust the code to supply the correct aria-labels/alt text.
1.bug_scenario:
The issue occurs in the Carbon React NumberInput story when you toggle certain knobs and run the IBM DAP accessibility checker.  

1. In the “disabled” state: the little red warning SVG icon used to indicate invalid input is rendered with role="img" but has no aria-label or aria-labelledby. This triggers “The WAI-ARIA widget with IMG role must have a non-empty alternate text or a label.”  
2. In the “form validation” state: the input element is given an aria-label of “Numeric input field with increment and decrement buttons” but the visible <label> text reads “Number Input label”. Because they don’t match or one does not contain the other, DAP flags “Accessible name must match or contain the visible label text.”  

Elements involved:  
- the <input type=number> wrapper (pattern, aria-label, id, min/max/step)  
- the red warning icon <svg> (role=“img”, missing alt text)  
- the form label (visible text vs aria-label mismatch)  
- the validation message text
